title: tests: pin clean-break and strict-parse rejections
description:
Missing negative tests that pin clean breaks and stricter parsing promised by CHANGELOG (batch 8b review, JMAP-0x0q.3/.5/.10/.41). Without these, a later alias or relaxed match passes unnoticed.

1. crate-jmap-filenode-types/tests/filenode_types.rs: nothing asserts the old "urn:jmap:chat:filenode:space" role string now parses as NodeRole::Other, not ChatSpace (CHANGELOG clean-break entry).
2. crate-jmap-chat-client/tests/message_smoke_tests.rs: no test that a legacy `rateLimited` SetError on the creation key returns Ok(set_resp) with the error in notCreated, not ClientError::RateLimited (src/methods/message.rs:314 matches only "rateLimit").
3. crate-jmap-chat-client/src/methods/message.rs:237-241, 314-322: documented UnexpectedResponse for a rateLimit SetError with malformed serverRetryAfter has no test.
4. crate-jmap-chat-types/tests/chat_tasks.rs: no test that `{"status":"completed"}` leaves `progress` None and keeps `status` in `extra` (draft-atwood-jmap-chat-tasks-00 L200-203 names `progress`).
5. crate-jmap-chat-types/src/ephemeral.rs: no test that a non-string wire `id` (e.g. `"id": 7`) is now rejected (draft-atwood-jmap-chat-wss-00 L185: `id` is a String); the CHANGELOG entry also does not mention the stricter parsing.
close_reason: Batch 9: committed and adversarially verified; CI green at df7e2035
